title.original: Fine-Grained Energy Prediction For Parallellized LLM Inference With PIE-P
title.zh: 使用PIE-P进行并行LLM推理的精细能量预测
title.en: Fine-Grained Energy Prediction For Parallellized LLM Inference With PIE-P

inclusion_reason.zh: PIE-P 为张量、流水线和数据并行推理提供阶段级多 GPU 能耗预测，是可复用的资源测量基础设施。
inclusion_reason.en: PIE-P provides phase-level multi-GPU energy prediction across tensor, pipeline, and data parallelism, making it reusable resource-measurement infrastructure.

abstract.zh: PIE-P 是面向多 GPU LLM 推理的细粒度能耗预测框架，覆盖张量、流水线和数据并行。它显式建模跨 GPU 通信、同步和并行化额外开销，以在缺少可靠硬件功耗计时器时估计各阶段能耗。
abstract.en: PIE-P predicts fine-grained energy for multi-GPU LLM inference across tensor, pipeline, and data parallelism. It explicitly models inter-GPU communication, synchronization, and parallelization overhead when reliable hardware power monitors are unavailable.

problem.zh: 现有预测器多针对单 GPU，无法分离并行推理中非确定通信、同步阶段和额外数据搬运的能耗，而实际功耗监控又常不可用或不准确。
problem.en: Most predictors assume one GPU and cannot isolate nondeterministic communication, synchronization, and transfer energy in parallel inference, while direct power telemetry is often inaccessible or inaccurate.

approach.zh: 框架通过精确采样、通信阶段的细粒度模型和并行额外开销核算，分别学习计算与通信能耗，再按所选并行策略组合预测。
approach.en: The framework combines precise sampling, fine-grained communication modeling, and explicit accounting of parallel overhead, composing compute and communication estimates for each parallelism strategy.

system_design.zh: PIE-P 的采样层采集推理阶段与通信事件，模型层分解各 GPU 的计算、传输和等待成本，聚合器再输出请求及阶段粒度的多卡能耗预测。
system_design.en: A sampling layer records inference phases and communication events, a model decomposes per-GPU compute, transfer, and wait cost, and an aggregator emits request- and phase-level multi-GPU energy estimates.

key_results.zh: 评测表明 PIE-P 在多种并行策略下给出准确、细粒度的能耗预测，并显著优于未充分建模通信的基线。
key_results.en: Evaluation reports accurate fine-grained predictions across parallelism strategies and clear improvement over baselines that do not model communication adequately.

limitations.zh: 预测模型需要针对硬件、互连和并行实现校准；摘要未说明动态电压频率、共享集群干扰或新 GPU 架构上的外推误差。
limitations.en: The predictor requires calibration to hardware, interconnect, and parallel implementation; extrapolation under DVFS, shared-cluster interference, or new GPU architectures is not described.

notes.zh: 三种并行策略、多 GPU 范围和预测基线类型来自官方摘要；模型、GPU、并行度、误差指标和数值待全文审计。
notes.en: Three parallelism strategies, multi-GPU scope, and predictor baseline class come from the official abstract; models, GPUs, degrees, error metrics, and values await full-text audit.
